item.title: Griffin dedicates community center to honor fallen hero Sgt. Todd Thomas
item.description: The city of Griffin dedicated a community center last week to honor Sgt. Todd Thomas, who died from COVID-19 in 2021, a year before his retirement.The Griffin Sgt. item.title: Parvo outbreak pauses animal intakes at Habersham County Animal Shelter

item.title: 2 utility workers injured after being struck by vehicle in Lawrenceville

item.title: Pickens County EMA director: Ping-pong sized hail, car damage reported
item.description: A pre-spring thunderstorm in North Georgia dumped quarter-sized, even half-dollar hail across Pickens County. The storm coated the ground with hail and made some roadways impassable for a short time.A powerful front moving through Georgia on Thursday prompted a severe thunderstorm warning for Pickens, Lumpkin, Gilmer, Dawson, and Fannin counties just after 7:40 p.m. Thursday. item.title: Officials debunk 'baseless' rumors of Hampton Police Chief Bo Turner's departure
item.description: The City of Hampton is clearing the air after they say several false rumors are circulating online concerning police Chief Bo Turner. Allegedly, the rumors claim that Morrow Police Chief Michael Crumpler is replacing Chief Turner. City government said it believes the accusations began with a disgruntled former City of Morrow employee who intended to disrupt operations in both cities. item.title: DeKalb County committee advances plan for homeless center after library shooting
item.description: A DeKalb County commission committee advanced a plan Thursday evening to open a day center for people who are homeless.The shooting at the Decatur Library earlier this month highlighted that it has become a gathering spot for those with nowhere else to go. item.title: Atlanta runners honor Olympian Jeff Galloway after his passing
item.description: Atlanta runners are finding ways to honor the legacy of former US Olympian Jeff Galloway, who was widely known for his run-walk-run strategy, after his death on Wednesday at 80. Officials say Galloway suffered a hemorrhagic stroke and died in a hospital in Pensacola, Florida. His daughter-in-law, Carissa Galloway, also a running enthusiast, shared a tribute to him through social media following his death.
